description: This file contains functions related to platform upgrade procedures, including image checking, copying configuration, and performing upgrades for a Linux-based embedded system. It handles partition comparison, image writing, and device management.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout has changed by comparing current and image partition tables. Extracts the boot sector from an image and compares its partition table to the original.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration file to the target partition, mounting it as vfat.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing image data to the device, comparing partition tables if needed, and updating partition UUIDs.
